name: v4.31.0
body:
## Highlights - **HTTP token.** Beyond loopback, as in Docker, HTTP needs `LINKEDIN_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN`. ([#1518](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1518) by @stickerdaniel) - **FastMCP 4.2.0.** Resource listings through the shared browser stay local again. ([#1513](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1513) by @stickerdaniel) - **Docker security fixes.** The image ships dnspython 2.9.2 and opentelemetry-api 1.45.2. ([#1515](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1515) by @stickerdaniel) ## Breaking Changes - HTTP beyond loopback now needs a bearer token, set with LINKEDIN_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN. ([#1518](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1518) by @stickerdaniel)
Bug Fixes (2) - The shared browser server answers resource listings again when its owner has stopped. ([#1513](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1513) by @stickerdaniel) - Installs get a new FastMCP, MCP SDK or httpx2 minor only after it is tested here. ([#1531](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1531) by @stickerdaniel)
## Install or update > [!TIP] > New here? The [README](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server#readme) covers setup. ### Update with uvx Clients configured with `mcp-server-linkedin@latest` pick up v4.31.0 on their next start. To pin this release, use `mcp-server-linkedin@4.31.0` instead. ### Update with the MCP Bundle For Claude Desktop, download [linkedin-mcp-server-v4.31.0.mcpb](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/releases/download/v4.31.0/linkedin-mcp-server-v4.31.0.mcpb) and open it to install or update. Bundles do not update themselves, so repeat this for every release. ### Update the Codex or Claude Code plugin Codex picks up v4.31.0 of the plugin in the background on its next start. In Claude Code, run this and restart: ```bash claude plugin update linkedin-mcp-server@linkedin-mcp-server ``` ### Update with Docker ```bash docker pull stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server:latest ``` Use the `4.31.0` tag instead of `latest` to pin this release. --- **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/compare/v4.30.0...v4.31.0
